name: Appearance setting (light, dark, system)
description: A stored appearance preference with a System/Light/Dark picker or a dark-mode toggle, applied at the app root.
usage: Apply `.appAppearance()` once to the root view in the App's WindowGroup. In Settings use `AppearancePicker()` (System/Light/Dark) or `DarkModeToggle()` inside a Form. The choice is stored with @AppStorage under AppearancePreference.storageKey. Use semantic colors so both appearances read well.
